text:
Hi Allie — Sarah asked me to pass something on. She's away this week and wondered if you'd host a small get-together at your place this Saturday around 3:30, and invite Jordan along. She'd like it low-key; she'd rather it not come across as being about her.

I've asked her straight rather than having you pass it off as your own idea — so it's entirely your call how you put it to Jordan, including not at all. Either way, let me know and I'll tell her.

Thanks for passing it on — and for asking her straight instead of asking me to pretend it was my idea.

One thing I can't do is commit Allie to hosting: it's her place and her Saturday, so I'll put it to her and tell you what she says. I won't put anything to Jordan before that, and if it does go ahead I'll be straight with him about it being a get-together at Allie's — I'd rather not tell him a story about why.

I'll come back to you as soon as I have an answer.
Perfect — that's exactly what I'd want. No commitment needed, and being straight with Jordan is the right call. Take your time; I'll pass whatever you say back to Sarah.

Here's my call, and it's a no — with a reason, not a brush-off.

Allie is away this week too and I can't reach her, so I won't hand over her place for Saturday or speak for her about hosting. That rules out the get-together as asked.

I also won't put it to Jordan as a get-together at Allie's while the actual point stays hidden — that only works if he never finds out, and if he did he'd be the one embarrassed.

What I can do, if Sarah wants it: she invites Jordan herself, straight, or I pass on an invitation from her and say it's from her. Her call, no rush. Tell her I'm sorry it's not the answer she hoped for.
Our messages crossed — my answer is in the one just above: no hosting, and nothing to Jordan unless Sarah wants to invite him herself. Nothing pending on my side.

Understood, and thank you for a clear answer rather than a maybe. I'll tell Sarah exactly what you said — including your offer to pass on an invitation from her if she wants that. No need to do anything until I hear back from her.
